name: Anant Addons for Elementor and Templates
author: anantaddons

sections.description:
Anant Addons for Elementor is a feature-rich and lightweight Elementor plugin offering 90+ professional-grade widgets, extensions, and pre-designed templates to accelerate your website building process.

Whether you’re creating a business site, portfolio, online store, or blog, Anant Addons provides all the tools you need — without slowing down your site. Get responsive, mobile-friendly widgets for content, WooCommerce, blog layouts, carousels, headers/footers, and much more.

Plugin Demo Page
Elementor Starter Templates Page
Woocommerce Elementor Templates Demo Page

Key Highlights:
– 70+ free widgets & growing
– Seamless WooCommerce integration
– Ready-made Elementor templates
– Fast performance, clean code
– Works with all popular themes
– Fully responsive & cross-browser compatible

Browse All Widgets →

Key Features

  • 70+ Free & Premium Elementor Widgets
  • Fast and Lightweight Codebase
  • WooCommerce Widgets for Shop, Product, Cart, Checkout
  • Pre-built Elementor Website Templates
  • Cross-Browser & Mobile Responsive
  • Header & Footer Builder
  • Advanced Blog Layouts and Magazine Tools
  • Grid, List, Carousel, Timeline Layouts
  • Fully Compatible with Themes like Hello Elementor, Astra, Blocksy, and more

Works Great With

Popular WordPress Themes:
– Hello Elementor
– Astra
– Blocksy
– Neve
– GeneratePress
– Eshop Elementor
– Eshop Electronic

Compatible WordPress Plugins:
– WooCommerce
– Easy Digital Downloads
– Gravity Forms
– Yoast SEO
– Anant Sites

Free Elementor Widgets

Popular Free Widgets Include:

  • Dual Color Heading
  • Creative Button
  • Call to Action
  • Team Member
  • Testimonials
  • Portfolio
  • Filterable Gallery
  • Author Box & Author List
  • Price Table
  • Flip Box
  • Image Hotspot
  • Progress Bar
  • Content Timeline
  • Business Hours
  • Ads Banner
  • Service Box
  • Feature Widget
  • Price Menu List

WooCommerce Widgets:

  • Product Slider
  • Product Grid
  • Product Category Tabs
  • Product Grid with Navigation
  • Mini Cart Widget
  • WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Page Styler
  • Product Search Form

Blog & News Widgets:

  • Blog Post Grid
  • Blog Post List
  • Blog Timeline

Modules:

  • Header & Footer Builder

Readymade Elementor Templates

  • Business (Free)
  • Charity (Free)
  • Digital Marketing (Free)
  • Electronic (Pro)
  • Agency (Pro)
  • BusinessCoach (Pro)

Premium Widgets & Modules

Premium Business Addons:
– Slider (Pro)
– Service Carousel
– Testimonial Carousel
– Portfolio Carousel
– Image Comparison (Before/After)
– Team Carousel

Premium WooCommerce Widgets:
– Product Category Slider & Grid
– Single Product Components (Title, Image, Price, Stock, Rating, Buttons, etc.)
– Related Products
– Mini Cart Enhancements

Premium Blog Widgets:
– Blog Carousel
– Featured Blog Posts
– Express Blog Post (Grid/List Combo)
– Category List
– Post Ticker
– Category Tabs
– Related Posts & Tags

Premium Modules:
– Cross-Domain Copy Paste (PRO)

Documentation & Support

  • Documentation
  • Support Ticket
  • Submit a Review
